title: oenothera fruticosa f. phyllopus
intro: Oenothera fruticosa f. phyllopus, commonly known as Fringed Evening Primrose, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the primrose family (Onagraceae). It is traditionally used to treat a range of health issues, including inflammation, pain, and wounds, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera fruticosa f. phyllopus include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting sedative and spasmolytic effects, making it a valuable plant for traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and unsaturated fatty acids, particularly gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), which has been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
